verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You were near
Though I was distant

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Disillusioned I was
Lost and insecure

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
Still mercy fought
For my attention

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
You were waiting at the door
Then I let you in

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Trading your life
For my offenses

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
For my redemption
You carried all the blame

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
Breaking the curse
Of our condition
Perfection took place

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
When only love could make a way
You gave your life in a beautiful exchange

verse.name: v3a
verse.lines:
My burden erased
My life forgiven

verse.name: v3b
verse.lines:
There is nothing that could take this love away
And my only desire and sole ambition
Is to love you just the same

verse.name: c2a
verse.lines:
When only love could make a way
You gave your life in a beautiful exchange

verse.name: c2b
verse.lines:
When only love could break these chains
You gave your life in a beautiful exchange

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Holy are you God
Holy is your name

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
With everything I've got
My heart will sing how I love you
